'''Lorant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and a member of a [[Pierce's black ops team|black ops team]] headed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
A former member of [[Pierce's black ops team]], Lorant got her promotion from [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by [[Reproduction/Legends|sleeping]] with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Galvan]]. She became his favorite and her connections landed her a post on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] by [[3642 BBY]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] recalled her back to the old team for a special occasion - [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] had authorized Pierce to go after [[Bastion (Corellia)|The Bastion]], the Republic's best defended military complex on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Pierce trusted no one else except his old teammates to be qualified enough for the job, but needed numbers, so he convinced Lorant to seduce Moff Galvan into providing them with reinforcements. When the team was fully assembled, Rakton excused her and the rest of the team from all other assignments and they headed for the Bastion. A couple of men under Lorant's command died during the assault, but eventually the fortress' gates were open. Pierce's team dealt with the security, killed the Bastion's commanding officer and took the base, securing a major victory on Corellia for the Empire.
